subject: Onboarding coordination: contract stitchboard & legal checkpoint
messages:
From: Audrey Lim <audrey.lim@pinegrove.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Dan Cho <dan.cho@pinegrove.com>, procurement@pinegrove.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to shift MSA redline walkthrough and onboarding checkpoint

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency profile you showed. We're close to finalizing terms but have a couple of conflicting priorities this week and need to shift the redline walkthrough.

Can we move the MSA redline call to Monday 8/17 between 10:00-12:00 PT? Also, Dan (cc'd) will attach the consolidated redlines; can your team confirm who will lead the legal walkthrough and who will join for an operational onboarding checkpoint (30m) the same week?

I've attached the current redline PDF and an updated mutual action plan. If Monday is not possible we'll propose alternate slots.

Appreciate it — Audrey

Attachments: Pinegrove_MSA_v2_redlines.pdf (PDF, 842KB), Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Audrey Lim <audrey.lim@pinegrove.com>
Cc: Dan Cho <dan.cho@pinegrove.com>, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to shift MSA redline walkthrough and onboarding checkpoint

Hi Audrey — great to hear from you and glad the demo resonated.

Monday 8/17 10:00-11:00 PT works for us for the MSA redline walkthrough. We'll allocate 60 minutes to give your legal team room to surface high-level changes and agree next steps. Proposed attendees from Redwood:
- Marissa Cole (Commercial Ops) — will drive the contract conversation and capture decisions
- Rishi Malhotra (Legal counsel) — will handle detailed redline questions
- Mina Haddad (Account lead) — program and onboarding questions

For the operational onboarding checkpoint, we can do a 30-minute slot on Wednesday 8/19 at 11:00 PT (same week). That session will cover SSO, data retention defaults, and rollout timeline. If you'd prefer the onboarding checkpoint immediately after the legal call, we can keep it to 20 minutes but recommend separating them so legal can finish without time pressure.

I've added both proposed calendar slots — please confirm which you prefer. I'll also upload the meeting notes template so we can track action items during the call.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

--
Redwood Inference | redwoodinference.com
From: Dan Cho <dan.cho@pinegrove.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Audrey Lim <audrey.lim@pinegrove.com>, procurement@pinegrove.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to shift MSA redline walkthrough and onboarding checkpoint

Thanks — confirmed for 8/17 10:00 PT.

Quick note from legal: we've consolidated comments into the attached PDF. The main asks are:
- Data handling: add clarification on encryption-in-transit and at-rest (section 4.2)
- Audit logs: retention window request (section 6.1)
- Termination assistance: request for export procedures (section 9.3)

Marissa/Rishi, could you confirm whether we should expect a redline turnaround within 48 hours after the walkthrough, and whether Redwood will table any counter-proposals during the call or follow up with a tracked-change file?

Attaching the consolidated redlines again for quick reference.

Regards,
Dan
Pinegrove Legal

Attachments: Pinegrove_MSA_v2_redlines.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dan Cho <dan.cho@pinegrove.com>, Audrey Lim <audrey.lim@pinegrove.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to shift MSA redline walkthrough and onboarding checkpoint

Dan / Audrey — confirmed on our side. We will: 
- Run the 8/17 10:00 PT redline walkthrough (60m). Rishi will join to handle clause-level discussion.
- Commit to returning a tracked-change response within 48 hours after the call unless we surface new items that require leadership review.
- Schedule the operational onboarding checkpoint for 8/19 11:00 PT as discussed; Mina will own the agenda and send a short prep note to your ops team.

Prep items for the redline call (can you confirm these before the meeting):
1) Final list of sections you consider must-have (Dan)
2) SSO provider details for onboarding session (Audrey)
3) Any procurement PO/create-commit steps we should know about (procurement@pinegrove.com)

I'll capture action owners during the call and share the MAP in the HubSpot record after. Looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
